name: dek-copilot-chat
description: Use AI models in GitHub Copilot Chat through Dek Gateway. Bring Your Own Key with native chat, tools, reasoning, and multimodal support.

commands.title: Dek Go: Show Usage Quick Pick

dekgo.temperature.description: Sampling temperature used for chat completions.

dekgo.maxTokens.description: Optional max output token override. Use 0 to request each Dek model's configured maximum.

dekgo.maxInputTokens.description: Optional context size override advertised to VS Code. Use 0 to advertise each Dek model's configured context window.

dekgo.debugReasoning.description: Write provider reasoning_content to the Dek output channel for debugging. Reasoning is not shown in Copilot Chat.

dekgo.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Total request timeout in seconds for Dek Go and Zen chat requests. Prevents long-running Copilot requests from hanging indefinitely.

dekgo.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Streaming idle timeout in seconds. If Dek stops sending response chunks for this long, the request is cancelled with a clear error.

dekgo.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show the latest Dek prompt/output/cache usage summary in the VS Code status bar after each response.

dekgo.showProviderPrefix.description: Show the Dek Go or Dek Zen provider prefix in model names.

dekgo.freeOnly.description: When enabled, only free Dek Zen models are shown in the Copilot model selector. Disable to include paid Zen models as well.

dekgo.agentsWindow.markdownDescription: Register separate agent-host providers for the Copilot Agents window. Disable to hide the Agents section entirely. Requires a window reload to take effect.

dekgo.showAgentModelsInManagePanel.markdownDescription: Show agent-host vendors in the Manage Language Models panel. When disabled (default), agent models still work in the Agents window but are hidden from the Manage panel to reduce clutter.

dekgo.stripThinkTags.markdownDescription: How to handle `<think>...</think>` tags in model output. `auto` strips tags only for known reasoning models that inline thinking in the content field (minimax), accumulating the extracted reasoning content into the existing reasoning fallback. `always` strips for every model. `never` passes text through unchanged (use if a model legitimately uses `<think>` in its output).

dekgo.thinking.deepseek.markdownDescription: Thinking mode for DeepSeek models (`deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`). Maps to `reasoning_effort`. `low`/`medium`/`high` adjust reasoning depth; `max` enables maximum reasoning.

dekgo.thinking.glm.markdownDescription: Thinking mode for GLM models. `high`/`max` enable thinking (interpreted as `on` for models that use toggle, e.g., GLM 5/5.1). Per-model picker shows only options supported by each model.

dekgo.thinking.kimi.markdownDescription: Thinking mode for Kimi models (`kimi-k2.5`, `kimi-k2.6`). Maps to `thinking: { type: 'enabled' | 'disabled' }`.

dekgo.thinking.minimax.markdownDescription: Thinking mode for MiniMax models (`minimax-m2.5`, `minimax-m3`, etc.). Maps to `thinking: { type: 'disabled'|'adaptive'|'enabled' }`. The Dek gateway only supports on/off for this family (`reasoning_effort` is silently ignored).

dekgo.thinking.mimo.markdownDescription: Thinking mode for Mimo (Xiaomi) models. Maps to `reasoning_effort`. `low`/`medium`/`high` adjust reasoning depth.

dekgo.thinking.qwen.markdownDescription: Thinking mode for Qwen models (`qwen3.5-plus`, `qwen3.6-plus`, `qwen3.6-plus-free`). Maps to `enable_thinking`. `auto` lets the model decide (omits the flag), `on`/`off` force-enable or disable hybrid thinking. Off is the recommended default to avoid empty Copilot replies.

dekgo.thinking.qwenBudget.markdownDescription: Optional `thinking_budget` for Qwen models when thinking is `on` or `auto`. `auto` omits the field. Ignored when Qwen thinking is `off`.
